description: This file defines the `CanvasManager` class, responsible for managing the canvas window, session handling, navigation, auto-navigation based on gateway updates, and debug/status UI updates within a macOS application. It includes methods for showing, hiding, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and resolving URLs for canvas routes.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing the canvas window and related session, navigation, and status functionalities in the macOS application.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the canvas session with a specified session key and optional target path or placement.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Displays the canvas with detailed parameters for session key, target, and placement, returning a `CanvasShowResult` indicating the outcome.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the current canvas session if it matches the provided session key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code within the current canvas session context.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the current canvas session, optionally saving to a specified path.
